pick.headline: Terry Anderson, the longest-held American hostage, is freed
pick.summary: On December 4, 1991, Islamic Jihad released Terry Anderson, the Associated Press correspondent kidnapped in Beirut in March 1985.
pick.significance: Anderson's release after nearly seven years effectively ended the Lebanon hostage crisis that had drawn the Reagan administration into the Iran-Contra affair.

alternates.headline: Kuwait Airways flight hijacked to Tehran; two Americans killed
alternates.summary: On December 4, 1984, hijackers seized a Kuwait Airways flight and forced it to Tehran, where they killed two US AID officials. Iranian security forces stormed the plane on December 9.
alternates.significance: The hijackers demanded the release of the Dawa prisoners held in Kuwait for the 1983 bombings, including of the US Embassy; Washington accused Tehran of complicity.
